sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator for a one-year term); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Reading, 2026 Warning (printed in the February 2026 Informer): Article 1 elects by Australian ballot on March 3, 2026 a Moderator (one year), Town Clerk (three years), Town Treasurer (three years), a Selectperson (three years), Trustees of Public Funds, a Cemetery Commissioner, and Library Trustees; Article 3 elects the Treasurer as collector of delinquent taxes; Articles 5 and 6 ask the voters to authorize appointing the Treasurer and the Clerk. Rayna Bishop held the seat to 2026; the 2026 outcome is published nowhere official, so the post is created without a membership
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Town of Reading, Town Report Fiscal Year Ending 2024, 'Elected Officials March 2024' table: Calista Brennan, Town Clerk on a three-year term expiring at the 2026 meeting

Town of Reading, April 2026 Informer (Selectboard minutes, March 9, 2026): the board took up hiring a Town Clerk and Town Treasurer after the meeting, and by July 2026 the minutes are submitted by an Assistant Town Clerk. Town of Reading, April 2026 Informer (Selectboard minutes, March 9, 2026): the board thanked Robert Hartnett for three years of service and welcomed Mike Sanderson; the board sits as Robert Allen (Chair), Lisa Silvester, and Mike Sanderson
